en.topic_title: ‘Following captain’s orders’: Asked about resigning over Tai Po fire, development chief likens self to crew under John Lee
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s development chief has likened herself to a sailor who must put her captain’s orders over her “personal wishes,” when asked by a reporter about calls for her to resign over the deadly Tai Po fire that killed 168 people last year.



Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
